caption: The drawing features two views of the same object, a bonnet, depicted in a realistic style on a plain, off-white background. The bonnet is dark in color, primarily rendered in shades of black and deep gray, with lighter highlights suggesting a smooth, possibly satin-like material. The inner lining of the bonnet, visible in the top view, is pale cream or light ivory with faint hatch lines indicating texture or quilting. The bonnet has a rounded crown with vertically stitched or quilted segments, and it is finished with long, wide black ribbons for tying, which are shown draped loosely in both views. The lower view shows the bonnet from the side, while the upper view displays it from an oblique angle, revealing the interior. The drawing is signed and numbered in small brownish-red text in the lower right corner: "Del. 133 Bayard Berndt."
title: Black Silk Bonnet
